questions.question: Write the word equation and the balanced chemical equation for the reaction of magnesium oxide with hydrochloric acid.
questions.expected_answer: Magnesium oxide + hydrochloric acid → magnesium chloride + water; MgO + 2HCl → MgCl2 + H2O.

questions.question: Describe how to prepare copper sulfate crystals from copper oxide and sulfuric acid, giving a reason for adding the oxide in excess.
questions.expected_answer: Warm dilute sulfuric acid; add copper oxide while stirring until some remains undissolved (excess, so that all the acid is used up); filter off the excess; evaporate the blue filtrate partly; leave to cool slowly so crystals form; dry them.

questions.question: Balance Fe2O3 + HCl → FeCl3 + H2O and state one industrial use of this reaction.
questions.expected_answer: Fe2O3 + 6HCl → 2FeCl3 + 3H2O. Used to remove rust from steel (pickling) before painting or galvanising.
